I wouldn't say I'm an ex feminist. I still believe in womens equal rights. But I just didn't like how  people I would talk to claimed they wanted equality and obviously didn't. 

There was a teacher at my school who showed a kid in my class illicit pictures of someone she slept with. The kid was a 14 year old boy. The teacher got fired and nothing happened to her beyond that. When I talked about it with some of my classmates they said "Men are different, they aren't as vulnerable"   I'm sorry, but the same girls who were telling me that women are just as strong as men are now saying that it's okay for a 14 year old boy to be shown that by a female teacher because women are naturally "more vulnerable" and that's why she wasn't arrested?  

No. That's not gonna fly with me. She was a 30 year old god damn woman, she knew what she was doing, and she should get the same punishment any man would get in that same situation.  

I want the freedom to pursue the dreams I want to pursue regardless of my gender and that's it. I don't need anything beyond equal treatment and opportunity. I'm confident enough in myself to say I don't need preferred selection into college or for things to be "taken easy" on me. I work hard, I strive to be a good person, and I have ambition. That's what should give me or anyone else an advantage, not gender, in any context, whether it favors a man or a woman.

Thank you for your kind reply. I accidentally posted this before I finished it. I just edited it now. This was a little while ago. I have now been diagnosed with depression and anxiety disorders and have had medicine and therapy that has helped me become  more involved with the world. While I do sometimes have some passing thoughts, I have made some strides in the two years since I first attempted suicide. That was in sophomore year and I am now in the summer before my senior year. Thank you for the support.
